title: fruitArchitecture User Manual
text: fruitArchitecture reconstructs annotation-derived signaling organization transcriptomic evidence. summarizes significant genes within predefined modules, measures strict gene overlap core modules, identifies Level 3A Level 3B organization, calculates architecture metrics, performs permutation-based Level 3B test, assigns architecture class, produces standard figures export tables. package accepts either: completed differential-expression table; RNA-seq count matrix sample design analyzed internally DESeq2. current default architecture PHMIES, contains core modules Plant hormone signal transduction, MAPK signaling, Information exchange. default definition also tracks seven additional recurrent modules: Circadian rhythm, Protein processing endoplasmic reticulum, RNA transport, RNA degradation, SNARE interactions, Autophagy, Sulfur relay system. Development status. Version 0.1.x early research-software release. weighted ISI, entropy, balance, robustness score, class thresholds implemented reproducibly, scientific definitions remain versioned treated provisional package methods paper validation analyses finalized.

title: Purpose and scope
text: fruitArchitecture reconstructs annotation-derived signaling organization transcriptomic evidence. summarizes significant genes within predefined modules, measures strict gene overlap core modules, identifies Level 3A Level 3B organization, calculates architecture metrics, performs permutation-based Level 3B test, assigns architecture class, produces standard figures export tables. package accepts either: completed differential-expression table; RNA-seq count matrix sample design analyzed internally DESeq2. current default architecture PHMIES, contains core modules Plant hormone signal transduction, MAPK signaling, Information exchange. default definition also tracks seven additional recurrent modules: Circadian rhythm, Protein processing endoplasmic reticulum, RNA transport, RNA degradation, SNARE interactions, Autophagy, Sulfur relay system. Development status. Version 0.1.x early research-software release. weighted ISI, entropy, balance, robustness score, class thresholds implemented reproducibly, scientific definitions remain versioned treated provisional package methods paper validation analyses finalized.
